Author: Kwuwa (based on PvP TopPlates by Petra105)
Name: Jarvis PvP
Description:
Draws clear plates for players in PvP above the 3D world: HP with barrier, MP and Limit Break bars, job icon, debuffs, sign markers and the enemies that have you as their target. Settings window with a live preview, four themes, diagnostics, shareable settings codes and English / French / German / Japanese / Russian texts.

Use /jpvp to open the settings. Based on PvP TopPlates by Petra105 (MIT licence).
Punchline: Clear PvP plates: HP, MP, Limit Break, debuffs, signs and who targets you.
Changelog:
1.1: Russian interface (game terms stay in English). Share your settings: copy a settings code and send it to friends, import a code from the clipboard, undo an import. Name colour for each group (enemies, party, alliance, other friendly players, yourself).

1.0: first public release as Jarvis PvP.
